extraction.text:
Vijay Kumar Kurakula

Hyderabad, India vijay.kurakula009@gmail.com • +91 9000138679

Microsoft 365 & Power Platform Consultant

Microsoft Power Platform Consultant with 4+ years of experience designing and delivering enterprise- scale business applications, workflow automation solutions, and digital transformation initiatives using Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, SharePoint Online, Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365, and Azure Services. Experienced in Canvas Apps, Model-Driven Apps, Custom Connectors, REST API integrations, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, and enterprise ALM practices using Azure DevOps and Git. Strong expertise in workflow automation, document management, governance, security, CI/CD deployments, and process optimization across HR, Finance, Operations, Procurement, and IT Service Management domains. Proven track record of reducing manual effort, improving compliance, and delivering scalable low-code solutions in enterprise environments.

WORK EXPERIENCE

Freshworks • Bengaluru, India • 08/2024 - 04/2026 Power Platform Consultant • Full-time

Designed enterprise-grade Power Platform solutions using Power Apps, Dataverse, SharePoint Online and Microsoft 365.

Developed Canvas Apps and Model-Driven Apps supporting Finance, HR and Operations processes.

Built complex approval workflows using Power Automate with SLA monitoring, escalation mechanisms and exception handling.

Implemented Azure Logic Apps and REST API integrations with external business applications. • Developed reusable components, custom connectors and automation frameworks to accelerate solution delivery.

Configured Dataverse security roles, business rules and governance policies. • Managed ALM lifecycle using Solutions, Azure DevOps, Git and deployment pipelines. • Integrated applications with SharePoint Online, Teams, Outlook and external systems. • Created monitoring mechanisms using Application Insights and automation reporting dashboards.

Collaborated with business stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver scalable digital transformation initiatives.

Key Achievements

Reduced manual effort by 65%. • Improved approval turnaround by 55%. • Reduced operational processing time by 45%. • Automated 25+ business processes. • Increased compliance and audit visibility across departments.

Value Momentum • Hyderabad, India • 05/2022 - 07/2024 Power Apps Associate • Developed enterprise Canvas Apps using SharePoint Online and Dataverse. • Built automated approval workflows using Power Automate Cloud Flows. • Managed SharePoint document libraries, metadata and permission structures. • Configured role-based access controls and document approval workflows. • Developed integrations with Outlook, Teams and external REST APIs. • Created responsive user interfaces and optimized application performance. • Participated in solution deployment, testing and production support activities. • Troubleshot workflow failures and implemented process improvements.

Key Achievements

Reduced document processing time by 50%. • Automated 15+ manual business processes. • Improved user adoption through optimized application design. • Reduced workflow failures through monitoring and error handling improvements.

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Business Administration in Finance Osmania University • Hyderabad, India • 07/2018 - 03/2022

CERTIFICATIONS

PL-400 Microsoft Power Platform Developer Associate Mircosoft

PL-200 Microsoft Power Platform Functional Consultant Mircosoft

PROJECTS

Enterprise Financial Control & Expense Management System Technologies: Power Apps, Dataverse, Power Automate, Azure Logic Apps, SharePoint Online, REST APIs, AI Builder

Highlights

Built enterprise expense platform handling multi-level approvals. • Integrated finance systems through REST APIs. • Implemented automated compliance checks. • Built executive dashboards and reporting. • Reduced approval cycle by 55%.

HR Lifecycle Automation Platform Technologies: Model-Driven Apps, Dataverse, Power Automate, SharePoint Online, Teams

Highlights

Automated onboarding, offboarding and employee lifecycle processes. • Implemented role-based security model. • Automated document generation and approvals. • Reduced onboarding effort by 60%.

IT Service Management Portal Technologies: Power Apps, Dataverse, Power Automate, Azure Service Bus, Azure Functions

Highlights

Built ticket management solution with SLA tracking. • Implemented automated escalation workflows. • Integrated notification services and reporting. • Improved ticket resolution time by 45%.

Contract & Compliance Management System Technologies: Power Apps, SharePoint Online, Power Automate, Teams

Highlights

Automated contract approvals. • Implemented expiry monitoring and compliance tracking. • Developed audit-ready document management solution. • Eliminated manual tracking activities.

SKILLS

Microsoft Power Platform: Model- Driven Apps Power Automate Cloud Flows Power Automate Desktop Dataverse AI Builder Copilot Studio Power Fx Custom Connectors Canvas Apps, Power Apps

Microsoft 365: SharePoint Online Microsoft Teams Outlook OneDrive Microsoft Forms

Dynamics 365: Dynamics 365 CRM Customer Service Sales Dataverse Security Model Business Rules

Integration: REST APIs JSON OData SOAP Webhooks OAuth Authentication

DevOps & ALM: Azure DevOps Git GitHub Solution Management Managed Solutions CI/ CD Pipelines Environment Variables Release Management

SharePoint Technologies: SharePoint Online Document Libraries Permission Management Metadata Management Document Management Systems Workflow Automation

sections.text:
PROJECTS
Enterprise Financial Control & Expense Management System Technologies: Power Apps, Dataverse, Power Automate, Azure Logic Apps, SharePoint Online, REST APIs, AI Builder
Highlights
Built enterprise expense platform handling multi-level approvals. • Integrated finance systems through REST APIs. • Implemented automated compliance checks. • Built executive dashboards and reporting. • Reduced approval cycle by 55%.
HR Lifecycle Automation Platform Technologies: Model-Driven Apps, Dataverse, Power Automate, SharePoint Online, Teams
Highlights
Automated onboarding, offboarding and employee lifecycle processes. • Implemented role-based security model. • Automated document generation and approvals. • Reduced onboarding effort by 60%.
IT Service Management Portal Technologies: Power Apps, Dataverse, Power Automate, Azure Service Bus, Azure Functions
Highlights
Built ticket management solution with SLA tracking. • Implemented automated escalation workflows. • Integrated notification services and reporting. • Improved ticket resolution time by 45%.
Contract & Compliance Management System Technologies: Power Apps, SharePoint Online, Power Automate, Teams
Highlights
Automated contract approvals. • Implemented expiry monitoring and compliance tracking. • Developed audit-ready document management solution. • Eliminated manual tracking activities.
